This page is generated from [`docs/dist-tag-policy.md`](https://github.com/beobungbu/BeeUI/blob/main/docs/dist-tag-policy.md) plus the root workspace manifest. Release-ready means the repository has the engineering controls required to produce/verify artifacts; it does **not** mean an npm package, CLI, Git tag or GitHub Release exists. Publication remains an explicit owner action.

Date-version labels such as `20260902.0.0` identify the current candidate workspace state. Prerelease/stable channels remain governed by the canonical distribution policy rather than historical RC evidence.
